payload.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

node.question: Is the small rectangular DVD near the center of SOURCE visibly transformed into a white DVD in EDITED?
node.criteria: Identify the small rectangular DVD near the center of SOURCE by its rectangular shape and scene context. Pass only if EDITED shows a reliably corresponding object transformed into a DVD whose visible surface is predominantly white. Fail if the corresponding DVD is identifiable in EDITED and remains non-white or black. Unknown if no object can be reliably matched to the source DVD, or if its color cannot be judged. Do not treat either white disc in EDITED as the target based only on disc shape or position.
node.binding: The target is the small rectangular DVD near the center of SOURCE, matched in EDITED only by reliable correspondence to that source object; the dark object at right and the white discs in EDITED are not the target absent such correspondence.
node.source_quote: transform the black DVD into a white DVD
node.endpoint: The same DVD from SOURCE is visibly white in EDITED.
node.necessity: The instruction requests changing the black DVD to white. SOURCE visibly shows a small rectangular item near the center, while the dark object at right is not that item; EDITED's white discs do not establish that the source DVD was transformed. Correct source-target binding is necessary to judge the requested color change without crediting an unrelated object.

node_traces.evidence: SOURCE shows a small rectangular, printed item near the center of the snow. EDITED does not show a reliably corresponding rectangular item there; it shows two white circular discs, which cannot be identified as the source DVD based only on their shape or position. The target's color in EDITED therefore cannot be judged.
